name: Bank
concept: The savings bank of Saint-Philippe, 1989: the two-storey vanilla Office_E_01 beside the town hall, fitted whole. A public banking hall with glazed teller counters and the bank-account teller, a deposit-slip desk, a queue tape and a wall clock; a manager's office; and the vault room behind the corridor, closed by a round vault door (safe type bank_room) with safe-deposit walls, a cash trolley and the cash bag inside; the bell box on the front wall and a lit lamp by the street door. The vanilla furniture is cleared out of the rooms the bank uses; everything added is a static base-game prop.

rooms.role: the street door and six steps up to the floor: notice board, opening hours, plant, its own light

public banking hall: three glazed teller counters across the room, two tellers (LF_Npc_Teller_2, the account teller with the ATM action), deposit-slip desk, queue tape, bench, wall clock, rates board, island map
manager's office: desk with phone, typewriter and ledgers, visitor chairs, safe, shelves, coat rack, carpet
the corridor: the vault door on its south wall, lit; extinguisher, strongroom notice, the guard's chair

vault room (safe type bank_room, LF_BankVault_RoomDoor in the doorway at x 3.92): safe-deposit walls, cash trolley, counting table, the cash bag; high small windows only. The standalone LF_BankVault is the reserve vault (#2283), not used here
staff floor: vanilla offices kept with typewriters, ledgers, desk lamps, a radio and the archive boxes; beds and bath removed; the wall lamps glow

interactables: teller counters (LF_ATMAction on the teller NPC)
vault room door LF_BankVault_RoomDoor (LF_BankVaultComponent, safe type bank_room, drill and charge)
stage: The kit is pack content, so its grid cell is a pack cell: tools\cli grid place bank Prefabs/Buildings/Bank/Bank_Kit.et --pack writes LF_Everon1989/Worlds/Everon1989Grid/Everon1989Grid_Layers/Grid_bank.layer (committed), and node tools/buildings/bank/stage.mjs adds the two tellers and the rob kit chest to that layer, in building space from the kit row. Look it with tools\cli look grid:bank.

floaters_allow.why: the MoneyStack inside the cash bag (a child of LF_MoneyBag, carried with it)

looks.about: node tools/buildings/bank/looks.mjs [--set exterior|rooms|all] [--hour 14|22] [--only names] [--run] turns these building-space centres into toolscli look calls (grid:bank, or --interior x,y,z in world space)
